## Platform, version gate & UAT seeding

The backend is up, ready, and tells old builds to update. Also proves the UAT
seeding path itself (tagged anonymous user, admin plan/credit changes) so
every later area can trust its preconditions.

### API (automated, live Alpha)

#### UAT-PLAT-001 — Health and readiness report green

_API (automated, live Alpha) · plans: anon_

**Steps**
1. GET /v1/health
2. GET /v1/ready

**Expected**
1. /v1/health is 200 with status "ok" and a git sha version
2. /v1/ready is 200 with ready true and no failed probes

#### UAT-PLAT-002 — Release floor blocks builds below min_build and passes current ones

_API (automated, live Alpha) · plans: anon_

**Steps**
1. GET /v1/client/release-floor to read min_build
2. GET /v1/client/release-floor?build=<min_build - 1>&platform=ios
3. GET /v1/client/release-floor?build=<min_build>&platform=android

**Expected**
1. The below-floor build gets action "block" and an Apple store/TestFlight URL (the generic TestFlight page until IOS_TESTFLIGHT_JOIN_URL is set — CR121)
2. The at-floor build gets action "ok" (or "nag"), and the Android store URL is a Play Store link

#### UAT-PLAT-003 — UAT seeding creates a tagged anonymous user the admin API can re-plan and credit

_API (automated, live Alpha) · plans: floor_pass, trader_

**Steps**
1. POST /v1/auth/anon with the UAT device tag
2. Admin PATCH plan to trader, admin POST credits +5
3. Admin GET the user

**Expected**
1. The user exists with last_app_version "uat" (excluded from real-user counts)
2. Plan reads trader and credits rose by 5
3. The user's own bearer token authenticates GET /v1/auth/me
